valid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { this.a = 1; this.b = cond ? 1 : 2; } }
valid.name: unconditional assignment (ternary only on the value, not the target) - not flagged

valid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { if (cond) { console.log('no assignment here'); } } }
valid.name: if statement with no this.* assignment inside - not flagged

valid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { switch (cond) { case 'a': this.type = 'a'; break; case 'b': this.type = 'b'; break; } } }
valid.name: switch whose cases all assign the SAME property - not flagged (same resulting hidden class every branch)

valid.code: class Foo { constructor() { this.helper(); } helper() { this.a = 1; } }
valid.name: helper method called from constructor, but with only an unconditional assignment - not flagged
if statement outside any class method - not flagged

invalid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { if (cond) { this.a = 1; } else { this.b = 2; } } }
invalid.name: if/else with this.* assignment in each branch - flagged (pre-existing coverage)

invalid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { switch (cond) { case 'a': this.a = 1; break; case 'b': this.b = 2; break; } } }
invalid.name: switch statement with differing this.* assignments across cases (bypass) - flagged

invalid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { Object.assign(this, cond ? { a: 1 } : { b: 2 }); } }
invalid.name: Object.assign(this, ternary) (bypass) - flagged

invalid.code: class Foo { constructor(cond) { this.init(cond); } init(cond) { if (cond) { this.a = 1; } else { this.b = 2; } } }
invalid.name: helper-method indirection: constructor calls this.init(), init() branches on this.* (bypass) - flagged
